answer_1.quote: We propose a persona‑aware variational response generator ... to model the conversations ...
answer_1.outputs: generated dialogue responses (replies) conditioned on user persona

answer_2.quote: To thoroughly evaluate our systems, both standard and persona‑focused metrics are employed ... For standard metrics, we adopt unigram BLEU (BLEU‑1) and Word Embedding metrics ... The three proposed metrics (uRank, uPPL and uDistinct) are adopted to measure the performance of capturing persona.

answer_4.quote: We also implement human labeling ... annotators are asked to decide whether the response can reflect persona for the given user ... For the evaluation of relevance, each query‑response pair is cross‑evaluated by 3 annotators.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators judge whether the generated response reflects the persona of the given user and assess relevance to the query.
